# Mobile1X

> Mobile1X is a software development studio that builds AI systems, fintech platforms, and performance-driven digital products for clients worldwide, and ships its own products including the Notes app, Dedup, The A2Z Collection, and Auction Manager.

Mobile1X works with startups, agencies, and enterprises globally and operates from India. Engagements typically run from $5,000 to $100,000+, with standalone web performance audits from $500. Contact: hello@mobile1x.com, +91 97545 25494 (phone/WhatsApp), or book a 30-minute discovery call at https://calendly.com/themobile1x/30min.

## Services

- [AI Systems & Automation](https://www.mobile1x.com/#services): Conversion-focused AI funnels, lead-scoring and qualification engines, AI landing systems, and automation workflows for high-ticket lead generation ($5K–$100K+ deals).
- [Fintech Platform Engineering](https://www.mobile1x.com/#fintech): Secure, scalable fintech systems for banks, startups, and enterprises; banking and payment API integrations; enterprise-grade security and compliance architecture.
- [Web Performance Audit](https://www.mobile1x.com/#services): Audits from $500 to about $5,000 that identify revenue leaks, speed issues, and scaling opportunities in an existing web platform.
- [Conversion Funnels & Landing Systems](https://www.mobile1x.com/#contact): High-converting forms, qualification logic, and automated follow-up and CRM pipelines.
- [SaaS & Enterprise Web Development](https://www.mobile1x.com/#portfolio): Full-stack product and platform engineering.

## Products

- [Notes](https://notes.mobile1x.com/): Fast, distraction-free note-taking app for Android.
- Dedup: Duplicate file remover and storage cleaner for Android.
- The A2Z Collection: E-commerce platform.
- Auction Manager: Cricket and sports player auction software.
- [B2B Pharma Platform](https://www.mobile1x.com/pharma/): Platform connecting pharmaceutical suppliers and buyers with catalog browsing, pricing, and ordering.
